Monster_Meenlock
Meenlocks are a type of fey creature in Act Two.
“
These crustacean-like Fey are spawned by fear and seek to destroy all that is good, innocent, and beautiful.
„
— In-game racial description

About Meenlocks

Meenlocks are crustacean-like critters with large, paralysing claws, and a presence which instills fear in their enemies.

Involvement

Seven of them are within the Selûnite shrine in the Last Light Inn - Cellar.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Claws ()
Damage: 1~10
3d4 - 2⁠Slashing
Lash out with venomous claw to  Paralyse your target.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Sense Hidden Presence ()

Search for Invisible creatures, possibly revealing them to others.

 Range: Self
 Shadow Teleport (Meenlock) ()

Teleport to a shadowy location.

 Range: 16 m (53 ft)
 Recharge: Per turn

Tactician

On tactician difficulty, meenlocks have an increased 18 Constitution and Dexterity, as well as higher health, AC, and initiative.

Loot

  • Bonecap
  • Covert Cowl
  • Dragon Egg Mushroom
  • Nothic Eye
  • Ochre Jelly Slime
  • Poison Spore

  • Timmask Spores
  • Tongue of Madness

Tactics

The  Fear Aura can be prevented or negated by  Calm Emotions,  Freedom of Movement, and  Protection from Evil and Good.

The  Paralysed condition can be cured with  Arrows of Salving,  Lesser Restoration, and  Remedial Potions.
